title: Shape with both filter and blendMode drops the blend in SWF — frames.ts filter-only branch ordering
description:
FIXED + verified (agent-1240).

Root cause: compiler/frames.ts shape INITIAL-placement else-if chain tested hasEnabledFilters() FIRST and emitted encodePlaceObject3WithFilters (no blend byte); the shape blendMode branch was else-if, unreachable when filters present. A shape with both filter+blendMode dropped the blend (byte-confirmed by QA).

Fix: unified the filters-only and blend-mode shape branches into ONE branch gated on (hasEnabledFilters || non-normal blendMode). When blend is present it calls encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode(charId,depth,x,y,blendMode,displayObj.filters,objTransform,...) which already writes FILTERLIST THEN the blend-mode byte (correct SWF PlaceObject3 field order) and sets HasFilterList(0x01)+HasBlendMode(0x02). Mirrors the already-correct instance path in the same file. Filters-only / blend-only fall to the single-feature encoder. CXForm (colorEffect/visible/alpha) + cacheAsBitmap preserved in the combined path. The frames.ts shape MOVE branch was already correct (checks hasBlend first, passes filters).

Regression tests: __tests__/blendmode.test.ts tests 7-9 — (7) shape filter+blend emits exactly ONE PlaceObject3 with HasFilterList AND HasBlendMode, blend byte=multiply(3), Blur FILTERLIST intact; (8) encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode writes FILTERLIST before blend byte; (9) filters-only and blend-only shapes stay correct.

Results: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build (typecheck) green; pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run => Test Files 115 passed, Tests 1446 passed (0 failures, no task-1207 fixture failures appeared). Updated docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md.
